title: Korea In November: What To Pack For Changing Weather
summary: Korea shifts from autumn to winter in November. Learn what layers to pack, how weather differs by region, and where to catch the last autumn colors.

slides.title: Pack For Two Seasons
slides.sub: Korea turns from autumn to winter
slides.voice: Korea in November swings from autumn to winter. Pack layers.

slides.title: Build Your Layers
slides.sub: Thin top, warm jumper, proper jacket
slides.voice: Start with a thin top, add a warm jumper or fleece, then wear a proper jacket. You can peel layers off indoors.

slides.title: Bring Winter Extras
slides.voice: For the second half of November, bring a padded jacket, hat, and gloves. Seoul nights can get close to freezing.

slides.title: Head South For Leaves
slides.sub: Colors last longer in the south
slides.voice: For autumn color, head south. Foliage often lasts there a little longer than in Seoul.

slides.title: New Korea tips
slides.voice: Subscribe for more Korea tips every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
